newsitem.title: UK: BT raises prices for third party mobile users.
newsitem.headline: BT raises prices for third party mobile users.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Wednesday it was raising retail prices for calls to services operated by Orange Plc and Mercury Communications' One 2 One mobile phone users.
The price changes will take effect on February 19, 1997 and reflect the increased payments that BT has to make to One 2 One and Orange from that date, it said.

BT said that calls would be charged at a new rate of 30 pence a minute between 0800 GMT and 1800 GMT Monday to Friday and at 20 pence a minute during weekday evenings and overnight. Weekends will be charged at 10 pence a minute.
The current rate stands at 16.71 pence a minute during the day and 9.85 pence a minute at all other times.
